name: Meeting agenda, notes and follow-ups
summary: Whoever runs the meeting walks in with an agenda where every topic has an outcome and a time, and walks out with a one-page record: what was decided, who owns each action and by when, and what is still open. Nothing reaches anyone until that person has read it and sends it.

sources.title: The paste-in form of the work, the gap list, the held-back rule, the follow-up draft and the acceptance tests.

sources.contribution: The agenda rules (an outcome for every topic, decision topics first, times that must fit the meeting, a closing read-back), a check that a meeting with nothing to decide or discuss could be a written update, moving an update into the reading when time runs over, and the rule that an action with no owner or no date is flagged for a person to settle.
The before-and-after shape of the work, a coded key for taking notes, and a record that keeps decisions, actions, parked items and open questions apart, each parked item with what brings it back.
